body_plan: upright biped with arms (humanoid): tall leaf-cloaked elder, antlers, staff in the left hand

rigid_parts.note: the staff + fist shell (cut free by meshfix/prop_surgery.py with meshfix/shaman_cfg.json), rigid in the left fist

notes: v22 enemy (Hollow region): Shaman, a gnarled elder (area special). Humanoid biped_arms rig. The leaf cloak IS the body (hood, beard face, cloak to the knees at the back); it is skinned by heat weighting to pelvis/spine/neck/head and follows the thighs softly at the hem. Left arm (-X): upper arm hangs from under the cloak, elbow at the side (y +0.06, z 0.47), forearm forward to the fist on the staff. Right arm (+X): hangs relaxed along the flank, hand at the hip. Staff: x -0.22, y -0.26, ground to a mushroom cap at z 1.2-1.37 beside the face -- rigid to arm_L_hand (rigid_parts). Antlers rise from the hood at x +-0.2, z 1.28 to z 1.9 -- rigid to head. Legs: thin, hips x +-0.125 at z 0.40, feet at y +0.10.

arm_ramp.note: arms emerge from under the leaf cloak: cloak vertices nearer the trunk than the arm (radius-normalised) hand their arm/clavicle weight to the nearest spine bone

_limit_note: arm_L_fore rest flexion is ~78 deg (forearm held forward on the staff): channel flex -70 straightens it to ~8 deg. arm_L_upper flex to 165 (a full overhead raise, inside human shoulder flexion ~180) for the Cast's staff-overhead
_prep: rigged from shaman_prep_v2: prep_mesh.py --no-ground-sheet -> eyefix/eyepaint.py (shaman_cfg.json, glowing eyes) -> meshfix/prop_surgery.py (shaman_cfg.json, staff ripped free)
_placed_by: v22: placed by the writer from z/x sections (coloured section tool), a staff-axis trace and the calibrated views; checked with tools/lmcheck.py. Spine at the section centres (pelvis z 0.44: 0.53/0.56; chest z 0.94: 0.54/0.56; head z 1.28: 0.49/0.51). The left arm hangs from under the cloak (shoulder x -0.235, z 0.66) to the elbow at the side (z 0.45) and runs FORWARD to the fist on the staff (y -0.19..-0.27): arm_roll_closing gives that forearm its true hinge. The right arm hangs along the flank. lmcheck OUTSIDE by design: both toe tips (1.7-1.8 cm under the thin feet, snapped) and the right hand tip (1.8 cm, the fingertips).

prop_clear.note: anim/prop_clear.py: where the staff would enter the hood, antlers or cloak, the shoulder abducts (up to 15 deg) and the wrist tilts the staff head outward (up to 25 deg), eased in and out
